source.author: lucan
source.text: Tot simul infesto iuvenes occumbere leto, Saepe fames, pelagique furor, subitaeque ruinae, Aut coeli terraeque lues, aut bellica clades Numquam poena fuit.
source.text_original: Tot simul infesto iuvenes occumbere leto, / Saepe fames, pelagique furor, subitaeque ruinae, / Aut coeli terraeque lues, aut bellica clades / Numquam poena fuit.
source.text_english: So many young men to fall together by hostile death, often by famine, by the fury of the sea, by sudden collapses, or by a pestilence of sky and earth, or by the disasters of war, was never a punishment.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: haec iterant segni flentes occumbere leto.
reuse.text_original: ' / haec iterant segni flentes occumbere leto.
reuse.text_english: These things they repeat, weeping, as they sink down to a sluggish death.
